meta.title: Document Search
meta.description: Adds optional PDF and Markdown full-document search readers with highlights, counts, match navigation and PDF page selection; keeps built-in readers.

ui.loading: Reading the complete document and indexing every page…
ui.bytesRequired: Complete file bytes are required. Reload the document.
ui.password: This PDF is encrypted. Use the built-in reader or decrypt a copy first.
ui.scanned: No searchable text found. Image-only PDFs require OCR; this reader does not perform OCR.
ui.pdfNote: Literal full-text search. Enter / Shift+Enter: next / previous; Esc: clear. Searches PDF text only, not across page or line breaks. Switch back to the built-in PDF viewer in the header.
ui.mdNote: Markdown source search includes markup and reads the entire file, not a rendered Markdown preview. Enter / Shift+Enter navigate; Esc clears. The built-in Markdown reader remains available in the header.
